data.title: Red Sea Global Opens The Ritz-Carlton, AMAALA
data.content:
Tabuk, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Red Sea Global (RSG) has opened The Ritz-Carlton, AMAALA, the largest resort at AMAALA. Framed by Tabuk mountains and the Red Sea, the resort sits directly on the marina at Triple Bay, close to AMAALA Yacht Club, Marina Village and the Corallium Marine Life Institute.
    Group CEO at Red Sea Global John Pagano said eight resorts have opened at AMAALA this year, and The Ritz-Carlton, AMAALA adds another dimension to the destination. The resort offers tennis, padel, pickleball, water sports, cycling and e-biking. Ritz Kids, a children's club, offers programs that nurture imagination, along with spaces and experiences designed for children.
    The resort is approximately 40 minutes by electric vehicle (EV) from Al Wajh International Airport and around two hours by EV from Red Sea International Airport.
    The waterfront property is the eighth resort to open at AMAALA this year, leaving just one of the destination’s nine planned resorts yet to open. Powered by 100% renewable energy and guided by regenerative tourism principles, the resort reflects RSG’s approach to responsible development. Across its destinations, RSG aims to achieve a 30% net conservation gain by 2040.
    -- SPA
